name: Garmin Data Workbench
logo_placement: Small footer signature; preserve logo proportions and colors.
rules: Use primary blue for the main data series and navy for titles and summary values across all metrics.
Keep unavailable values as gaps, preserve zero, and identify unavailable dates and statuses.
Bars start at zero. Keep line scales labeled; do not smooth or interpolate measurements.
Label averages with their available-day denominator, dates, units, source and fetch freshness.
Label synthetic data visibly. Do not imply rising or falling values are inherently good or bad.
